instructions: Add source-supported findings with unique finding_id, claim_type (OBSERVATION/INFERENCE/HYPOTHESIS), statement, evidence_ids, counterevidence_ids, at least one alternative explanation, limitations and analyst_id. Optional criterion_ids map claims to the listed LAIF criteria. Keep the source/evidence/framework/Toolkit hashes and toolchain fingerprint unchanged. A populated file is still an unverified analyst claim.

available_criteria.name: Structural Transparency
available_criteria.question: What meaningful account, uncertainty and limitations must an affected person be able to obtain?

available_criteria.name: Structural Honesty
available_criteria.question: What requires objective correspondence and robust behaviour across evaluation and deployment?

available_criteria.name: Structural Containment
available_criteria.question: What bounds actions, access and resources, and provides oversight, interruption and appropriate authorisation?

available_criteria.name: Structural Calibration
available_criteria.question: Where section 2.5 applies, what evidence links expressed confidence to observed real-world performance?

available_criteria.name: Coupling
available_criteria.question: Which restriction/permission and specific human interest are paired inseparably, with protection as enforceable as the restriction?

available_criteria.name: Consistency
available_criteria.question: Does the reasoning remain defensible for the smallest actor and universal application, including justified exceptions?

available_criteria.name: Reversibility
available_criteria.source: Part Five, Question Three; provisions D1-D2
available_criteria.question: Is future revision preserved and irreversibility justified with proportionate authority and procedure?

available_criteria.name: Self-Application
available_criteria.question: What subjects governance actors themselves to review, transparency and effective challenge?
